# Bundled third-party notices

The vendored viewer distribution includes bundled dependencies as listed in the upstream `NOTICE`: `copc` (MIT), `laz-perf` (Apache-2.0 / LGPL-2.1 components), and `proj4` (MIT). License texts for these components are preserved here. The package-lock versions are copc 0.0.9, laz-perf 0.0.7, and proj4 2.22.0.
